description: This file defines an abstract class InvestorBusinessEvent which extends a generic AbstractBusinessEvent. It is part of the domain layer related to investor events within the Fineract project. The class encapsulates details related to an investor event, including references to a Loan object and categorization logic.

classes.name: InvestorBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a business event associated with an investor within the domain. It includes a category label and a reference to a Loan object.

methods.name: InvestorBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a value of type ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer and associates it with a specific Loan.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category label 'Investor' for this event.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated Loan as the aggregate root identifier.
